shots.p: birds and trees glorifying in the dawn light
a man promising and failing to act, empty hands
a man breaking his promise, disappointment
two ranks standing firm like a solid wall of stone
a man walking away from a lamp-lit house
a distant land with a light on the horizon
a man inventing lies in a dark corner
people trying to blow out a lantern that keeps burning brightly
the sun rising above all other lights
a man walking a path toward a bright horizon, profitable trade
believers spending their wealth for good
lush gardens with rivers flowing beneath
a city gate opening at sunrise, victory near
believers standing together supporting one another
